title: Enchanted Apple
description: A simple mod that adds the Enchanted Apple as a new step between the Apple and the Golden Apple.
body:
**Features**:
> Can be found in Dungeons:
- Desert Pyramid
- Jungle Pyramid
- Abandoned Mineshafts
- Dungeon (Monster Spawners)
- Stronghold...
  
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Desert Pyramid loot chance: ~18%
- Jungle Pyramid loot chance: ~20%
- Abandoned Mineshafts loot chance: ~10%
- Dungeons loot chance: ~15%
- Stronghold loot chance: ~2%

**_Additional:_**

Spawn Bonus Chest: ~3%

</details>

>**_Enchanted Apple Effects:_**

- Regeneration I (13s)
- Resistance I (8s)



>**_Can be traded with villagers:_**
- Farmer
- Cleric

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Farmer: random trade chance (trade lvl4)
- Cleric: random trade chance (trade lvl3)

</details>

>**_Can be dropped by a witch:_**

- Drop chance: ~8%



>**_Can drop from leaves:_**
- Oak Leaves
- Dark Oak Leaves

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Oak Leaves drop chance: ~0.03%,
- Dark Oak Leaves drop chance: ~0.04%

</details>
